title_en: APARTMENT 1+1+ KITCHEN FOR SALE IN SIRI KODRA!
description_en: The apartment is located on the third floor of an existing building, on Siri Kodra Street, very close to Selvis. It is offered fully furnished and is organized in: A living room / hall A distribution corridor A separate kitchen A bedroom A toilet A closed balcony The area in which it is located and the favorable floor make this property a very good opportunity for living and investment. The property has regular mortgage documentation and it is possible to buy it with a loan. For more information, or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
